summaries.summary: The Israeli election remains undecided with nearly 90% of the votes counted, showing no clear winner as coalition talks begin.
Apple has introduced touchscreen laptops at higher prices, marking a significant shift from its previous MacBook policy.

Upwind raised $400 million after opting against an acquisition offer; Microsoft disclosed Azure's revenue reaching $33.2 billion and its commercial revenue from OpenAI at $10 billion. Meanwhile, Google expanded its AI search ads globally.
Cyclone Arnab is expected to weaken into a depression, resulting in significant disruptions and destruction in India following its landfall.
The Supreme Court of India is questioning the Election Commission about discrepancies in voter registration forms during the Delhi State Election.
Jio Platforms saw a significant share price increase on its market debut, highlighting investor confidence.
Reddit has adopted a 'For You' feed model, emulating popular social media trends to enhance user engagement.
Apple's newly envisioned foldable iPhone's hinge was reportedly designed using AI technology.
The aftermath of a deadly train collision in Spain prompts national mourning as investigations into the tragic event continue.
